draft.emotion: wincing slightly while pointing to a sore spot, pained and needing relief
notes: Usually written as one separable verb ('wehtun': 'tut weh', 'wehzutun'), though 'weh tun' is also permitted.
Takes a dative object for the person feeling the pain: 'Der Kopf tut mir weh' (My head hurts).
Irregular forms of 'tun': er tut, er tat, er hat getan.

senses.definition: To cause physical or emotional pain; to ache.
